hero.title: {{CITY}}'s Trusted Veterinary Hospital
hero.subtitle: Expert Care for Your Beloved Pets
hero.description: {{COMPANY_NAME}} provides compassionate, full-service veterinary care for dogs, cats, and small animals across {{SERVICE_REGION}}. From wellness exams to surgery and 24/7 emergency care, our team treats every pet like family.

ctaSection.title: Your pet's health is our priority.
ctaSection.description: Whether it's a routine checkup or an urgent concern, our caring veterinary team is here to help. Schedule an appointment or call us today.

points.title: Compassionate Care
points.description: We treat every pet with the gentleness, patience, and respect we'd want for our own animals — and we keep you informed every step of the way.

points.title: AAHA Accredited Standards
points.description: Our hospital meets the highest standards in veterinary medicine, from anesthesia safety and pain management to cleanliness and recordkeeping.

points.title: Expert Specialists
points.description: Our veterinarians bring deep experience in surgery, dentistry, and internal medicine — advanced care for your pet, all under one roof.

points.title: 24/7 Emergency & Same-Day Care
points.description: When your pet needs help fast, we're here around the clock — with same-day sick visits and round-the-clock emergency support.
